Build and deploy Grafana with Docker Compose

Build Grafana from source and run it locally with one make command. Everything runs in containers.

Features Quick start Targets Settings Troubleshooting Changelog

Features

  • Builds the image from the repository Dockerfile.
  • Deploys with Docker Compose and waits for the health check.
  • Keeps Grafana data in a named volume.
  • Runs the tests/ folder in a container.

Quick start

make compose-deploy

Then open http://localhost:3000 and sign in with admin / admin, or the values in .env. The first build takes a long time.

Make targets

TargetDescription
compose-envCreate .env from .env.example.
compose-configValidate and print the Compose configuration.
compose-buildBuild the image.
compose-upStart Grafana without rebuilding.
compose-deployBuild, start, and wait until healthy.
compose-downStop containers. Data is kept.
compose-restartRestart Grafana.
compose-logsFollow logs.
compose-psShow container status.
compose-testRun tests/ in a container.
compose-cleanRemove containers, data volume, and image.
obs-upStart VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, and the GPU simulator. See the GPU observability stack.
stack-upStart the observability services, Keycloak, Grafana, and mcp-grafana together.

Settings

Set these in .env.

VariableDefaultDescription
GRAFANA_IMAGE / GRAFANA_TAGkekaflow/grafana / devImage name and tag.
GRAFANA_PORT3000Host port.
GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USERadminInitial admin user.
GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORDadminInitial admin password. Change it beyond local use.
PLATFORM / JS_PLATFORMlinux/amd64Runtime and frontend build platform.

For production Kubernetes deployments, use Helm.

Troubleshooting

  • Slow build on Apple Silicon: the frontend builder runs under amd64 emulation. Give Docker at least 8 GB of memory.
  • Timeout waiting for healthy: run make compose-logs.
  • Port in use: set GRAFANA_PORT in .env.
  • Clean slate: make compose-clean, then make compose-deploy.

Changelog

  • Added make compose-* targets and docker-compose.yml to build and deploy Grafana.
  • Added make obs-* and make stack-* targets for the GPU observability stack. compose-test now also runs the simulator unit tests.
